blocks.title: Technology Days and Smart Manufacturing Summit

blocks.body:
09:00 am - 09:30 am
Welcome & Breakfast Networking

Light breakfast and coffee with the ZOLLER team. Informal networking opportunity

09:30 am - 10:15 am
Executive Press & Partner Briefing: "What’s New at ZOLLER" — Mr. Alexander Zoller — President ZOLLER Inc.

Key Topics:

  • ZOLLER’s 80th Anniversary – Our legacy of Innovation
  • Industry Trends & Smart Manufacturing – How ZOLLER is driving Efficiency, Precision, and Automation for Companies of all Sizes
  • Product & Technology Announcements – Exclusive first look at new Solutions, Updates, and Road maps
  • Company Growth & Future Outlook – How ZOLLER will change the future of Manufacturing
  • Launch of the 2026 Toolroom of the Year Competition

10:15 am - 10:30 am
From CAM to Part – experience LIVE how the entire Portfolio of ZOLLER Solutions works together to guarantee smart and efficient Manufacturing Processes

  • Live integrated demo of ZOLLER Tool Presetting, Data Transfer, Balancing, Shrinking, and Automation Solutions

10:45 am - 12:00 pm
Live Q&A & Media Interviews/Technology Demonstrations

  • Open Floor for Press & Partner Questions
  • Technology Demos for Press/Partners
  • Prescheduled interviews with Mr. Alexander Zoller -President ZOLLER Inc.

12:00 pm - 01:30 pm
VIP Networking Lunch for Press & Partners

  • Invite-only luncheon with Press, OEM Machine Tool Builders, Software Partners/Resellers/Distributors, and Business Partners.
  • Opportunity for strategic Discussions in a relaxed Setting.

01:30 pm - 03:30 pm
Presentations & Sessions

  • Session 1: Driving Efficiency in Production with ZOLLER (Customer success stories & best practices)
  • Session 2: The Future of Smart Manufacturing
  • Session 3: Automating the Tool Room

04:30 pm - 06:00 pm
Cocktail Reception & Facility Tours

Informal networking with press, partners, and customers

06:00 pm -
Conclusion of Press & Partner Day

items.title: Day 2 - May 14, 2026 - Focus - Maximizing efficiency from CAM to Part

blocks.body:

Registration & Networking

Welcome & Keynote
Alexander Zoller, President of ZOLLER Inc., keynote “Innovation since 80 Years” will highlight the history and vision of how ZOLLER enables companies of all sizes to thrive and win in today's competitive business environment.

09:30 am - 10:15 am
Latest ZOLLER Solutions & Automation Technology Premieres & Live Demo
What’s new at ZOLLER? Unveiling the latest ZOLLER Technologies and Automation Solutions to maximize Efficiency at your Shop!

10:15 am - 10:30 am
Coffee Break

From CAM to Part – experience LIVE how the entire Portfolio of ZOLLER Solutions works together to guarantee smart and efficient Manufacturing Processes
Live integrated demo of ZOLLER Tool Presetting, Data Transfer, Balancing, Shrinking, and Automation Solutions

11:00 am - 11:30 am
Partnering with ZOLLER to improve Production Efficiency- a Customer Success Story
Jonathan Meeker, Tooling Engineer & CNC Programmer at Milacron, will present their journey to greater efficiency and precision with ZOLLER.

11:30 am - 12:00 pm
Launch of the 2026 Toolroom of the Year Competition

12:00 pm - 01:00 pm
ZOLLER 80th Anniversary Celebration Lunch!

Experience authentic German Cuisine and Beverages!

01:00 pm - 01:30 pm
Partnering with ZOLLER to improve Production Efficiency – Customer Success Stories
Customer success is the driver for everything we do at ZOLLER - we analyze several customer road maps to elevating efficiency, across a wide range of industries and companies – Interactive Q&A

01:30 pm - 02:00 pm
ZOLLER Automation
Interactive Demo featuring the »roboBox« and the game changer for pulling your components, assembly, heat shrink and measuring your tools autonomously

02:00 pm - 02:15 pm
Coffee Break

02:15 pm - 02:45 pm
Effective tool management for efficiency and productivity at your shop
Cedric Hasenfratz – ZOLLER TMS & Partnership Manager

How can companies leverage ZOLLER TMS to get complete control over their tooling and production processes?

02:45 pm - 03:15 pm
Tool Balancing – When & Why – Live demo and discussion
Nelu Bilba, Manufacturing Productivity expert, ZOLLER Inc.

04:00 pm - 07:00 pm
Happy Hour, BBQ and Live Music

08:30 am - 04:00 pm
All Day – “Meet the Experts”
One on one meetings with our technical experts to help you craft your roadmap to efficiency at your shop with ZOLLER Solutions
